title: Detection Finding event (per-rule detection-asset meta-finding for the detection-engineering rule lifecycle)
summary: OCSF Detection Finding events the detection_engineering playbook emits at the measure-rule-version step as the meta-finding describing each rule version itself as a detection asset, and that the threat_intel_ingest playbook downstream consumers emit at runtime on SIEM rule match against the armed indicators. Carries the rule identity, lifecycle state, and the OCSF source-data shape the rule queries against — the inventory shape the kpi.detection_coverage@v1 metric reads to count production detections bound to in-scope ATT&CK techniques.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 Findings category — Detection Finding class (uid 2004)
